Good questions

Before you ask

Is hotel pickup really included?
Yes. Free pickup and drop-off at your hotel or Airbnb in the Punta Cana / Bávaro / Cap Cana area is included. No extra charges, no small print.
How do I book and pay?
Message us on WhatsApp with your date and number of people. We send a secure card payment link (Stripe) and your spot is confirmed instantly with a ticket — the same protected payment you'd get on Booking or Viator, at a lower direct price.
What happens if it rains?
Tours run rain or shine in light weather. If the port authority cancels departures for safety, we move you to another date free of charge.
Is it suitable for kids? How do children's prices work?
Yes — most tours are family friendly: kids 2–12 pay half price ($32.50 on $65 tours) and under 2 go free. Buggies and ATVs are $45 per person sharing a vehicle, with family buggies for 3–4 riders. For the dolphin swim, kids under 1m join free with an adult on the Funtastic program.
Are there hidden costs?
No. Transport, lunch and open bar are included where listed. Optional extras are clearly optional and never pushed.
Why is your price lower than the big booking sites?
We're the local operator — you book direct with us on WhatsApp, so there's no 20–30% platform commission built into your price.
